fact: Setup resolves the scope of each requested write from the command argument and subsequent direct replies in the current conversation; an empty or vague approval requires clarification.
A Setup response distinguishes capabilities found in the tool catalog from remote permissions verified by an access check.
For a bare command with ready model settings, report the status and end the turn.
Setup readiness depends on models and environment; fact and glossary registration belongs to Fact Management.
The Setup agent refreshes the catalog when the user requests a model check or the available models may have changed.
Compare model assignments in one row per role, with a column for each of Work, Plus, Pro, and Pro Plus.
When proposing model assignments, preserve valid explicit assignments outside the requested change.
Before an approved model write, Setup presents the TSV using the effective save policy and asks about a new path or tracking policy only for a requested policy change.
For a requested write, quote the user’s authorization for that specific operation in approvedBy.
Setup completes approved operations through their named tools and reports receipts; a missing or failed tool leaves its operation pending.
When the catalog supports only one meaningful plan, present that plan and explain the constraint.
